adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `refreshAccessToken` now does `const res = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then reads `const token = res?.data;` followed by `token.access_token` / `token.expiry_date`. But `refreshOAuthTokens`’s sync-mode branch returns the result of `fetch(...)` (`Response`), which does not have a `.data` property (it requires `await res.json()` etc.). Therefore in sync mode `token` will be `undefined` and `token.access_token` will throw, breaking google-calendar refresh when `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` is used.
